name: Caipirinha
description: Cachaça muddled with whole lime and sugar over crushed ice.

histamine.note: Spirit plus muddled whole lime, peel included.

nutrition.highlight: the whole lime, peel and all

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. Built on a full measure of cachaça, it delivers as much alcohol as a straight spirit despite the muddled lime and sugar. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
